### Reconstruction

**Outcome:** parity.
**Scope:** parameter agreement.

**Comparison basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

[Open reconstruction report](../reconstruction-reports/feo_b8_2.md#record-feo_b8_2_fischer_2011_bm3_1)

Original audit code: `parity`.

**Limitations and qualifications:**

- Recovered combined thermal reproduction: all 21 numerical B8 volumes in Fischer Supplementary Table S1 are evaluated at their reported, already 3%-corrected temperatures with Equation (1)'s integrated-Gruneisen Mie-Gruneisen-Debye model. One-peak detections have no volume and are excluded; the three two-peak volumes whose errors are unconstrained use Figure 3's explicit +/-0.1 cm^3/mol fallback. All 8 B8 rows in Ozawa's printed Table 2 are added, and K0', theta0, q, Tr, and n are held fixed. The unweighted 29-row fit recovers every free coefficient within its published uncertainty. Fischer does not state its regression weights, residual variable, covariance, or optimizer, so this establishes numerical parameter parity rather than exact procedural identity. See the \[dedicated Fischer reproduction\](literature-reproductions/fischer-2011-feo.md).
- This named numerical assessment alone does not establish author-workflow reproduction, physical accuracy or recommendation for use.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Thermal equation choices</summary>

- **Debye temperature law:** integrated\_gruneisen

</details>

Fischer et al. report a thermal EOS for iron-saturated FeO, not a standalone 300 K BM3. The Fe0.94O starting powder was mixed with Fe and the authors treat the equilibrated high-P-T oxide as approximately stoichiometric FeO. Reported sample temperatures already include the source's 3% downward axial-gradient correction and must be evaluated at their tabulated values. The current-study supplement contributes 21 numerical B8 volumes; one-peak detections have no volume and are excluded, while Figure 3 assigns +/-0.1 cm^3/mol plotting errors when two-peak uncertainties could not be constrained. Ozawa's printed Table 2 contributes 8 B8 P-V-T rows and is bundled at printed precision. Fischer's exact combined row selection and regression weights/objective are not printed. The source explicitly warns against extrapolating this EOS far beyond the B8 data range.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Experimental Methods, pages 6-8; Equation (1) and equation-of-state section, pages 12-14; Table 1; Figures 2 and 3; Supplementary Table S1 (mmc1.xls).
- **Equation:** Equation (1): a 300 K BM3 reference isotherm plus Mie-Gruneisen-Debye thermal pressure; no explicit anharmonic or electronic thermal-pressure terms.
- **V0:** Table 1: 11.997 +/- 0.018 cm^3/mol, fitted because B8 FeO is not recoverable to ambient conditions; converted here to the conventional Z=2 B8 cell.
- **K0:** Table 1: 137.8 +/- 0.9 GPa, fitted.
- **K0 prime:** Equation-of-state section and Table 1: fixed at 4 because of the limited B8 P-T range.
- **Theta0:** Equation-of-state section and Table 1: fixed at the B1 value, 417 K, because of the limited B8 P-T range.
- **Gamma0:** Table 1: 1.73 +/- 0.12, fitted.
- **Q:** Equation-of-state section and Table 1: fixed at 1 because of the limited B8 P-T range.
- **Tr:** Equation (1) defines P300 and subtracts the Debye energy at 300 K.
- **N:** Two atoms per FeO formula unit; this is the Debye energy normalization, not a fitted coefficient.
- **Fit scope:** Equation-of-state section and Figure 3: present B8 observations plus Ozawa et al. (2010); Kondo et al. (2004) and Fei and Mao (1994) are plotted for comparison and are not fit inputs.

</details>

## Observation datasets

### feo\_fischer\_2011\_table\_s1\_pvt

- **Description:** All 52 synchrotron X-ray diffraction observations in supplementary Table S1, including the B1-FeO and B8-FeO molar volumes used in the phase-specific EOS fits and the coexisting NaCl and iron measurements.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_temperature\_multiphase
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Fischer; Campbell; Shofner; Lord; Dera; Prakapenka
    - **Year:** 2011
    - **Source:** Earth Planet. Sci. Lett.
    - **Volume:** 304
    - **Locator:** 496-502
    - **DOI:** 10.1016/j.epsl.2011.02.025
- **Source location:** Supplementary Table S1 (mmc1.xls)
- **Associated EOS records:** feo\_b8\_2\_fischer\_2011\_bm3\_1
- **Notes:** The dataset preserves the official workbook's full numeric precision, normalized to 12 significant digits. Asterisks are represented by b8\_observation=detected\_one\_peak\_no\_volume; dagger marks are represented by b1\_observation=rhombohedrally\_distorted\_detected\_no\_volume; double-dagger rows retain the measured B8 values and their blank raw uncertainty. The separate B8 fit-uncertainty column copies every constrained workbook value and assigns 0.1 cm^3/mol only to the three double-dagger volumes, following the Figure 3 caption; it remains blank when no volume was measured. The supplement labels numeric error columns generically with +/- and does not define a statistic. Temperatures are the reported values after the paper's 3% axial-gradient correction, not values reduced to 300 K.

[Observation resource](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/datasets/feo-fischer-2011-table-s1-pvt.csv)

### feo\_ozawa\_2010\_table2\_pvt

- **Description:** All 20 representative P-V-T rows printed in Ozawa et al. Table 2: 12 B1 FeO and 8 B8 FeO observations with coexisting hcp-Fe volumes.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_temperature\_multiphase\_with\_calibrant
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Ozawa; Hirose; Tateno; Sata; Ohishi
    - **Year:** 2010
    - **Source:** Phys. Earth Planet. Inter.
    - **Volume:** 179
    - **Locator:** 157-163
    - **DOI:** 10.1016/j.pepi.2009.11.005
- **Source location:** Printed Table 2, journal page 160
- **Associated EOS records:** feo\_b8\_2\_fischer\_2011\_bm3\_1
- **Notes:** Parenthesized uncertainties are expanded to absolute numeric values at the printed precision; blank cells mean that Table 2 prints no uncertainty. The source states that pressure was determined from hcp-Fe using Dewaele et al. (2006), with pressure uncertainty below +/-5 GPa dominated by temperature uncertainty; radial temperature variation was about +/-10%. Table 2 is the article's available row-level EOS source and is explicitly described as representative volumes. No Ozawa supplementary dataset exists.

[Observation resource](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/datasets/feo-ozawa-2010-table2-pvt.csv)
